text:
camille: Quick Q — we're finalizing client guidance for 429s. For per-route quotas, do we want SDKs to expose Retry-After as-is or compute a backoff helper? Example header/body proposals below, thoughts?

sriram: I'd keep Retry-After opaque from the server and treat it as the authoritative signal. Add an "X-RW-Quota-Remaining" and "X-RW-Quota-Reset" for observability. SDKs can expose a helper fn that returns retry_until based on Retry-After when present. :+1:

jordan: One nit — Retry-After precision varies (secs vs HTTP-date). SDKs should prefer numeric seconds when available, fall back to date parsing. For short bursts (<5s) we might want to return a 'soft' hint so clients can retry quickly.

maya: +1 on the helper. Proposal: include a tiny header set to make client behavior explicit. Example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
X-RW-Quota-Remaining: 0
X-RW-Quota-Window: 60
X-RW-Burst-Window: 5
```
This tells SDKs the window and burst tolerance used to compute the rejection.

kevin: If we add X-RW-Burst-Window, SDKs will likely smooth client retries over that window. That's OK but we should document *not* to implement aggressive token-bucket emulation that hides load spikes from the server. Also consider adding a recommended-backoff-ms in the JSON body for clients that prefer machine hints.

olivia: Minor compatibility thought: HTTP headers are case-insensitive but some client libs are picky. In docs show both header names and example lowercased keys for common JS/Go libs. Also include a machine-readable JSON body fallback.

camille: Drafting a suggested error body shape: 
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "scope": "per-route",
  "retry_after_ms": 12000,
  "hint": "reduce QPS or use dedicated capacity",
  "quota_id": "route:generate_text:default"
}
```
Any objections?

sriram: LGTM. One addition: include a stable "quota_id" so callers can correlate retries to the same accounting bucket across responses. Helpful for client telemetry.

jordan: SDK checklist I'll open PR for: expose isRateLimited(resp), getRetryAfterMs(resp), getQuotaId(resp), and opt-in backoff_jitter (default 0.2). Will add unit tests for both sec and HTTP-date Retry-After parsing.

deploy-bot: camille deployed docs update -> staging (build #4583) :rocket:

camille: Thanks y'all — if no objections I'll merge the API doc this afternoon and ping SDK owners to add the helpers. tagging @maya @jordan for follow-up implementation. :handshake:
